cat > /workspace/tmp/t_u64.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
import kit

big = 2 ** 64 - 1
module = {"name": "m", "params": [["a", "U64"], ["b", "U64"]], "result": ["r", "B"],
          "requires": ["lt", ["var", "a"], ["const", "U64", big]]}
campaign = {"types": [{"name": "U64", "kind": "int", "bits": 64},
                      {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"}],
            "modules": [module], "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": ["m"],
            "machine": None, "runs": []}
_, plan = kit.plan_for(campaign)
campaign["runs"] = [{"entry": "m", "ktest": kit.encode(
    [(n, kit.leaf(w, v)) for (n, p, w), v in
     zip(plan["slots"], [big, big - 1, 0])])},
    {"entry": "m", "ktest": kit.encode(
        [(n, kit.leaf(w, v)) for (n, p, w), v in zip(plan["slots"], [0, big, 1])])}]
out = kit.run_cli(campaign)
print(json.dumps(out))
assert out["plans"][0]["slots"][0][2] == 8
assert out["corpus"][0]["inputs"] == {"a": 0, "b": big}
assert out["corpus"][0]["model_result"] is True
assert out["records"][0]["status"] == "FILTERED"      # a == big is not < big
print("U64 OK")
PYEOF
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 t_u64.py
